features.label: Coordinate import
features.limitation: Single bounded objects for SDF, XYZ, MOL2, and PDBQT; sequence/map/trajectory files are not admitted.

features.label: Multi-object workspace
features.limitation: Objects currently use identity transforms and explicit coordinate-frame policy for cross-object spatial queries.

features.label: Selection and clear
features.limitation: Unsupported valid operators remain explicit capability outcomes.

features.label: Representation and visibility
features.limitation: Renderer-qualified profiles; exact PyMOL pixel parity is not claimed.

features.label: Scoped color
features.limitation: Named schemes are limited to the ColorRegistry.

features.label: Fit, center, orient, projection
features.limitation: Presentation state only; no coordinate mutation.

features.label: Distance, angle, dihedral
features.limitation: Geometry is tied to canonical coordinate revisions.

features.label: Ligand context rail
features.limitation: Actions expose bounded proximity diagnostics; no unvalidated interaction class or docking score is inferred.

features.label: H-bonds, contacts, clashes
features.limitation: Coordinate/profile based diagnostics with explicit limitations.

features.label: RMS/RMS_CUR/FIT/ALIGN/SUPER
features.limitation: Reference conformance remains unverified; CEALIGN is unavailable at runtime.

features.label: Session and scenes
features.limitation: Movie playback and advanced persistence are planned.

features.label: Tokenized safe command console
features.limitation: Host Python, shell, arbitrary process, filesystem, and network execution are rejected by design.
